name: Adenum
description: AD enumeration: LDAP port check, AS-REP roasting (GetNPUsers), Kerberoasting (GetUserSPNs), SMB share enumeration, LDAP search. Requires impacket + ldap-utils.

ad_null_session.description: Check if LDAP port 389 is open on a DC.

ad_asrep_roast.description: AS-REP roasting: find accounts with pre-auth disabled (returns crackable hashes).

parameters.users: Optional path to username list file

ad_kerberoast.description: Kerberoasting: request SPN tickets crackable offline.

ad_smb_shares.description: Enumerate SMB shares on a host.

ad_full.description: Full AD recon: port + AS-REP + SMB + LDAP (+ Kerberoast if creds).
